capabilities: Track anime, manga, and novels as Markdown notes
Search metadata via Bangumi, AniList, and Open Library
Record progress, releases, ratings, and pairwise rankings
Browse covers, images, and a completion timeline
Export library, scoreboard, and ranking as JSON, Text, or PNG
extras: Full usage docs live in a separate User Guide; README warns to back up the vault before Settings → Updates & cleanup operations and not to delete the .obsidian/animelist-ranking.json file. No telemetry; personal data stays in the vault. Interface localizes to five languages while the Settings page stays in English.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track a personal anime, manga, and novel collection with metadata, covers, progress, ratings, and release info while keeping plain Markdown notes as the source of truth.
